audience: engineering and project teams that track work in Jira Cloud

useCases.title: See your open work
useCases.text: Get the signed-in user, then search issues with JQL, such as the open issues assigned to you.

useCases.title: Review what changed on an issue
useCases.text: Read an issue with its fields, then its change history and its comments.

useCases.title: Check the workflow of a project
useCases.text: Read a project, list the statuses of each issue type, and list the transitions open for one issue.

useCases.title: Create a new issue
useCases.text: List the issue types, then create one issue in a project with a plain-text description. The tool only creates; it does not edit or delete.

useCases.title: Move an issue and explain the change
useCases.text: Get the transitions open for an issue, move it to the new status, then add a plain-text comment.
